title: HouseVis: devices
description: The devices that show the house. Each device has, per orientation, a sequence of pages; a page shows views from the views/ folder placed on it, or the Loxone web interface alone. Which device the Windows app shows is chosen in its menu and stored; without a choice, "default" applies. See docs/devices.md.

^(\\$schema|_.*)$.description: Reference to the schema or a comment; ignored.

default.description: Id of the device the Windows app shows without a choice of its own.

icon.description: An icon: "set:name" (sets in src/model/iconSets.ts, e.g. "lucide:sofa", "fluent:fire") or a bare name of the place's own set; with a colour (one-colour sets only, e.g. Lucide) an object.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 40 characters (also UUIDs).

platform.description: desktop: Windows, macOS and Linux (they behave the same); android; ios.

aspect.description: Screen shape in landscape as a ratio, e.g. 16:10; portrait swaps it. Only for the editor's preview.

keepAwake.description: While the app is on screen, the display neither dims nor sleeps (e.g. a wall tablet). Default false.

presenceRoom.description: A room of house.json with a presence datapoint: while it reports nobody there, the screen turns black (Android: lowest backlight) and the app keeps running; presence brings it back at once, and a tap wakes it for a minute. The screen then never sleeps, as with keepAwake.

lightMode.description: How light sources are drawn on this device: real with three.js lights, simple with glowing bodies and painted pools of light, for weaker devices (docs/lights.md). Default: simple on android, real otherwise.

reducedFrameRate.description: Every animation (presence glow, anemometer, moving windows, clouds, rain, snow) steps 10 times a second instead of 30, for weak devices. Default false.

portrait.description: If missing, the landscape pages apply (and vice versa).

title.description: Short text in the navigation bar.

icon.description: The page's icon in the navigation bar: a Lucide name from the app's list (src/model/pageIcons.ts, e.g. "sofa"), "set:name" for another set ("fluent:fire"), { "icon": "lucide:sofa", "color": "#7aa2ff" } for a colour, or "none" for the title alone.

components.description: What the page shows, each placed in percent of the page: views, and optionally a clock, a date, data panels and cameras.

weather.description: Only with components: the current weather as the page's sky behind all its views, rain or snow lightly over them (docs/weather.md). Needs the weather roles in house.json ("data"); drawn once however many views the page holds.

loxone.description: The Loxone web interface, alone and filling the page, wherever the user left it (it cannot be steered from outside). No settings yet.

area.description: Position and size in percent of the page.

cameraComponent.description: A camera's picture (docs/cameras.md): snapshots refreshed every "interval" seconds, or with "live" the camera's live picture. Drawn over the page's views like a data panel; a page may hold several.

id.description: Unique among the page's camera components.

frame.description: Drawn with a frame and the camera's name.

live.description: The live picture instead of snapshots (a camera without one shows snapshots). Best on a page of cameras alone: decoding video costs a tablet.

panelComponent.description: A data panel: Loxone values side by side, each with an optional icon and name and the value in its format; drawn over the page's views like the clock (docs/values.md). A page may hold several.

direction.description: The entries next to each other (horizontal, the default) or one below the other.

frame.description: Drawn on a dark plate with a border.

panelEntry.description: One value of a data panel. More fields may come (e.g. icons depending on the value).

name.description: Shown with the value; absent or empty: no name.

icon.description: "set:name" (a bare name is Fluent), or with a colour an object; absent: no icon.

format.description: Loxone's format of the value, copied from the structure file, e.g. "%.1f kWh" or "%.0f%%". Absent: the number as it is.

loxoneAddress.description: A state of a Loxone control, as in datapoints.json: the control's UUID (uuidAction, a subcontrol with a suffix such as "/AI1") and the name of the state.

view.description: Id of a view in views/.

frame.description: Drawn with a frame and its title.

hideLabels.description: The view shows no temperatures, indicators or weather panel, only the house. Default false.

labelScale.description: Size of the view's temperatures, indicators and weather panel in percent of their usual size. Default 100.

widgetComponent.description: clock: the current time; date: today's date in its long form with weekday and month. Both as the device's system settings format them (language and region, 12 or 24 hours), the text filling the area; drawn over the page's views. Each at most once per page.
